name: Navigate department pages and open the model booking form
description: Verifies visitors can reach the dedicated service pages from the main navigation.
steps: Navigate to Events, Weddings and Models & Talent
expected: Each selected service opens its own page with service-specific information and an enquiry path.

name: Submit a model enquiry and open WhatsApp with the selected requirements
description: Verifies the talent enquiry form captures the required booking brief and hands it to WhatsApp.
steps: Enter a name, choose Female model, choose Fashion / apparel and select Lucknow
expected: WhatsApp opens with the name, model requirement, shoot type and location included in the message.

name: Submit a service enquiry and hand off to WhatsApp
covers: WhatsApp phone number and message handoff
description: Verifies a mobile visitor can submit a service enquiry and continue in WhatsApp.
steps: Enter a name, choose Lucknow and enter a project brief
expected: WhatsApp opens to +91 91184 74846 with the selected service, city and brief pre-filled.

name: Show transparent Uttar Pradesh network coverage
description: Verifies the locations page describes the regional network as service areas rather than claiming unverified branch offices.
expected: The page identifies Lucknow as the coordination hub and clearly explains that other cities are service areas subject to confirmed local availability.
